Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner ignored the WebSurfer’s findings (Ehretia ≈66 species; Xanthoceras monotypic) and instead asserted incorrect counts (Xanthoceras ~12; Ehretia ~2), misusing sources (IPNI lists names, not accepted species totals; APNI/APC is regional to Australia). This faulty synthesis led to the wrong conclusion that Xanthoceras has more species.
